messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: EVAL-GATE ALERT: safety/regression gate tripped for route /v1/chat (hosted). 5m failure rate = 3.8% (threshold 1%). Tests failing: toxic_content, privacy_leak, output_drift. Eval run: https://redwood/internal/evals/5472 — paging SRE oncall now.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty PD-8734 fired -> escalation policy: SRE-oncall -> eng-sre-lead. Notifying @oncall.

rahul: acked. i'm on it. grabbing eval logs + model routing table. ping me if you see customer noise. :eyes:

rahul: quick triage — correlation with model variant traffic spike at ~2026-03-14T13:47Z. checking deploy history.

deploy-bot: Deploy record: deploy_id=dl-20260314-2347, model=gptx-26k-quant-v2 (canary), initiated by chris, completed at 2026-03-14T13:47:22Z.

chris: confirming, rolled canary per rollout policy (5% traffic). no immediate alerts in smoke tests, but eval gate is higher sensitivity — looks like canary failing safety checks.

maya: product here. any customer tickets so far? severity?

jess: support: two incoming tickets flagged as low-confidence outputs (CUST-1123, CUST-3345). Both reported hallucination of PII-like content. Marked P2, assigned to me. Drafting replies.

rahul: running quick split by model variant — 92% of failing evals hit gptx-26k-quant-v2. That's our canary. Recommend rollback to previous variant and enable fallback routing.

chris: agree. starting rollback to gptx-26k-quant-v1 for hosted pool. command:
```
# rollback canary
redwood deploy rollback --env hosted --model gptx-26k-canary --to gptx-26k-quant-v1 --reason "safety eval gate trip"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback queued. Estimated route propagation: ~60s. Will report status updates.

rahul: toggling emergency fallback: set routing policy to prefer stable variants for 15m.

incident-bot: Routing change applied. Fallback policy: stable-only for routes: /v1/chat, /v1/generate. Monitoring eval gate.

(30s later)

incident-bot: Eval gate metrics update: 1m failure rate -> 0.9%, 5m failure rate -> 1.1%. Trending down.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8734 acknowledged by rahul. Escalation paused. Next escalation time window cancelled.

rahul: leaving notes in incident ticket INF-2591. preliminary cause: quantization mismatch introduced in gptx-26k-quant-v2 leading to higher safety classifier triggers and occasional hallucination patterns. Follow-ups: full eval-suite run on staging, compare quantization config, add pre-deploy eval check for safety thresholds.

chris: runtime note — while rolling, we observed fp16 kernel path triggering slightly different softmax scaling on long-context prompts, which may amplify hallucination signal. I have a patch to normalize softmax input scales, will test on staging.

anna: i'm coming on for handoff in ~25m. rahul — any actions you want me to take on handover? I'll take ownership if still monitoring.

rahul: thx — handoff checklist added to INF-2591: 1) verify failure_rate < 0.5% over 30m; 2) run quick regression eval set locally against gptx-26k-quant-v2 build; 3) confirm rollback completed and traffic fully shifted; 4) coordinate customer comms with jess. i've added logs and the deploy diff to the ticket.

jess: prepping status page + customer messages. Draft: "We detected elevated safety regression alerts affecting a small number of customers. We rolled back a canary model variant and are monitoring; no widespread impact. If you experienced issues, please reply with example outputs and request id." Will post after anna/rahul confirm.

incident-bot: Monitoring: 15m window: failure rate stabilized at 0.3%. Safety checks green. No new customer tickets in the last 10m.

rahul: PD-8734 -> mitigated. i'm going to close the immediate page but leaving INF-2591 open for root cause + preventative changes. Will follow-up in postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8734 status updated -> mitigated by rahul. If recurrence, PagerDuty will re-fire.

anna: taking over monitoring. I'll run the full eval-suite on the canary artifact in staging and validate quant configs. Ping me if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:

chris: will prepare a minimal patch for softmax scaling; if staging passes we'll coordinate a patch rollout with a controlled canary and synthetic eval gating.

maya: product: will prepare customer-facing summary after postmortem. Thanks team for quick rollback. :bow:

jess: posting status update now. copying support replies into INF-2591 for context.

rahul: final note — created follow-up tasks: INF-2592 (add pre-deploy safety eval), INF-2593 (increase canary observability for quantized variants), assign leads. Good job everyone.

anna: acknowledged. i'm on watch for the next 45m then will spin up postmortem doc if everything remains stable.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging; incident ticket INF-2591 remains open for follow-up.
